extracted_concepts.name: Vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Abstract set with vector addition and scalar multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector in R^n
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An ordered n-tuple v = (v₁, v₂, ..., vₙ).

extracted_concepts.name: Ordered n-tuple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ordered list of n real numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Componentwise sum u + v = (u₁+v₁, ..., u+vₙ).

extracted_concepts.name: Scalar multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Componentwise product cv = (cv₁, ..., cvₙ).

extracted_concepts.name: Linear combination
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: w = c₁v₁ + ... + cₖvₖ for vectors v₁, ..., vₖ and scalars cᵢ.

extracted_concepts.name: Span
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The set of all linear combinations of given vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear independence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: c₁v₁ + ... + cₖvₖ = 0 implies c₁ = ... = cₖ = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linearly independent spanning set for a vector space.

extracted_concepts.name: Dimension
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The number of vectors in any basis of a vector space.

extracted_concepts.name: Finite-dimensional vector space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A vector space with a finite basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relates coordinates under two bases B and B'.

extracted_concepts.name: Transition matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P satisfies [x]_B' = P⁻¹[x]_B.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector of coordinates [x]_B relative to a basis B.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of column space = dimension of row space.

extracted_concepts.name: Column space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Space whose dimension is the rank of A.

extracted_concepts.name: Row space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Space whose dimension equals the rank of A.

extracted_concepts.name: Nullity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimension of the null space.

extracted_concepts.name: Null space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Space whose dimension is the nullity of A.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: rank(A) + nullity(A) = n.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations understood through vector spaces and matrices.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Arrays used to represent linear equations and transformations.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maps between vector spaces.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental invariants
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Basis and dimension are fundamental invariants.

extracted_concepts.name: Invariance of basis size
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Any two bases for a finite-dimensional vector space have the same number of vectors.
